description: Drafts a pre-order for a time slot, for PICKUP (default) or courier DELIVERY (method: delivery, with deliveryAddress or savedLocationId; the slot must offer delivery and the venue must deliver, and the delivery fee is paid to the rider on delivery) (bakeries, caterers; items marked soldAheadOnly) . Nothing is placed or reserved: it checks the slot against the items (lead time, capacity, items sold that day), prices the order with choices, and returns the summary: slot and ready time, items, total, what is due now and what on collection. Choose the slot with list_preorder_slots (slotInstanceId). Returns a draftId for place_preorder. Requires the connected WaitApp account. payment: on_collection (default; pay the venue when collecting) or mobile_money (the amount due now is paid by a prompt on the guest's own phone); some venues require mobile_money. guestPhone is required: the guest and venue use it to find the order. One slot per order; for different dates make separate orders.

deliveryAddress.description: For delivery: the full address. Not needed when savedLocationId is given

guestName.description: Who collects, or receives, the order

mobileMoneyNumber.description: Required for mobile_money: the guest's own mobile money number

savedLocationId.description: For delivery: one of the person's saved locations (see list_saved_locations)

name: draft_preorder
title: Draft a scheduled pre-order
